name: codex-hud
description: Local tmux HUD for the active Codex CLI session

interface.shortDescription: Show live Codex session telemetry in a tmux HUD
interface.longDescription: Adds an opt-in, local-only five-line tmux HUD for the current Codex account and session. It displays official-parity context pressure, tool and subagent activity, Todo progress, cache usage, estimated API-equivalent cost, quotas, and elapsed session time.
